import sys,resource,signal,time,json
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175));signal.alarm(180)
start=time.monotonic();cpu=time.process_time()
paths=['scripts/check_constructive_delivery_v34.py','scripts/test_check_constructive_delivery_v34.py']
def pins():return {p:{'bytes':Path(p).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths}
before=pins()
import pytest
class Ledger:
 def __init__(self):self.ids=[];self.phases=[]
 def pytest_collection_finish(self,session):self.ids=[i.nodeid for i in session.items]
 def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report):self.phases.append([report.nodeid,report.when,report.outcome])
l=Ledger();status=int(pytest.main(['-q','--tb=short',paths[1]],plugins=[l]))
assert status==0 and len(l.ids)==75 and len(set(l.ids))==75
assert len(l.phases)==225 and all(p[2]=='passed' for p in l.phases)
assert before==pins()
assert not any('editions_v' in n or 'alpha_enrollment_v' in n for n in sys.modules)
peak=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss;peak=int(peak if sys.platform=='darwin' else peak*1024);assert peak<=1536*1024*1024
print(json.dumps({'exit':status,'cases':len(l.ids),'phases':len(l.phases),'id_sha256':sha256(('\n'.join(l.ids)+'\n').encode()).hexdigest(),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-cpu,'peak_rss_bytes':peak,'pins':before,'network_calls':0,'alpha_imports':[],'actual_stage_reads_by_tests':0}))
